d: In this episode of Rajdoot, Hosted by Nikhil, Written by Sajid, we look at the dramatic return of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, how President Donald Trump personally intervened to bring him back, and why Wall Street's concerns over falling stock prices may have influenced the decision. We explore the allegations surrounding Huang's alleged relationships, the Chinese espionage concerns involving Alice Huang, and why US intelligence agencies were worried about potential national security risks.
